name: Schimera
description: A physically modeled human voice: every sound comes from a simulated airway (lungs, vocal folds, tongue, lips, nose), not samples. Speak a line of text at a key's pitch, sing it a syllable per key, or play a held vowel and sweep it with pad pressure. Port of jamesondh's CHIMERA engine, lightened to run on the Move.
author: legsmechanical (engine: Jameson Hodge / CHIMERA)
